metadata.title: The Uninvited Heir
metadata.subtitle: I was the quiet caretaker of the Thorne estate—until the matriarch's lawyer texted at 1 AM: 'She left 51% to you.'

nodes.text: 01:04 AM · The night after billionaire matriarch Eleanor Thorne passed. You are packing your suitcase in the servants’ wing.
{{player_name}}, do NOT pack your bags. Madam Thorne’s sealed estate deed names YOU controlling heir of 51% of Thorne Holdings.
51%?! Mr. Sterling, there has to be a mistake—I just managed her garden and read to her every evening!
Edgar, throw {{player_name}}’s suitcases onto the wet gravel at 7 AM and change every lock before the lawyer arrives!
Your services are no longer needed, {{player_name}}. Leave your keys on the kitchen counter by 7 AM sharp.

nodes.transcript: [warm, respectful] Madam left a private audio letter for you, {{player_name}}. She said her own children didn't visit once in three years—only you stayed until her last breath.

nodes.prompt: Celeste is arriving at 7 AM with movers to evict you. How do you greet her?

options.label: Wait calmly in the main foyer with Sterling
options.player_reply_text: Edgar, brew Madam’s favorite Earl Grey for 7 AM. Tell Mr. Sterling I’ll be in the foyer.

options.label: Ask Sterling why Celeste was cut out
options.player_reply_text: Wait, Mr. Sterling—did Madam leave a specific reason for cutting Celeste’s share?

nodes.text: Right away, {{player_name}}. It will be my honor to serve the true heir.
SECRET CLAUSE: Madam Thorne discovered Celeste tried to secretly sell the family estate to a casino developer while Madam was still alive!
The signed pre-sale contract is in my briefcase. Celeste has no idea her mother caught her.
Pulling up to the gates now with the locksmiths. You better be off MY property, {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: Changing the Locks
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Celeste orders the locksmiths to change the doors—and you calmly tell them which locks to change.

nodes.text: 07:02 AM · Grand Foyer. Celeste clicks in on designer heels, pointing furiously at you sipping tea.
How dare you sit in my mother’s chair?! Edgar, call security and have {{player_name}} arrested for trespassing!
I wouldn’t do that, Miss Celeste. As of midnight, this estate and 51% of Thorne Holdings legally belong to {{player_name}}.
Call my lawyer!! Tell him to contest the will for mental incompetence right now!!

nodes.transcript: [polite, lethal] Madam anticipated a legal challenge, Miss Celeste. She had three independent doctors certify her lucidity on video.

nodes.prompt: Celeste trembles with fury. How do you assert your new authority?

options.label: Tell the locksmiths to change HER gate code
options.player_reply_text: Good thing you brought locksmiths, Celeste. Change the main gate code—and remove her key.

options.label: Reveal her secret casino pre-sale contract
options.player_reply_text: Also, your mother saw the casino pre-sale contract you signed behind her back. That’s why you got 0%.

nodes.text: Edgar politely hands Celeste her coat and opens the grand oak doors toward the driveway.
TOTAL COLLAPSE: Celeste’s younger siblings hear about the casino betrayal and instantly vote to strip her from the family board too!
You won’t survive one week in that boardroom, {{player_name}}! They’ll eat you alive!
Don’t worry about me, Celeste. Your mother taught me everything she knew.

nodes.headline: Long Live the New Heir
nodes.teaser_text: Mr. Sterling leans in quietly: "One more thing, {{player_name}}. Look at the birth certificate sealed at the back of the will—Eleanor wasn’t just your employer."

nodes.text: 2:15 PM · Thorne Estate Library. The wax-sealed birth certificate from the back of the will trembles in your hand.
Read the maternal line carefully, {{player_name}}. Matriarch Eleanor didn’t leave you 51% out of charity—you are her biological granddaughter.
Wait… my mother was Eleanor’s younger daughter who disappeared twenty-four years ago?!

nodes.caption: SEALED KINSHIP REGISTRY · 99.96% Maternal Granddaughter DNA match — Verified by Eleanor six months ago.

nodes.text: Eleanor recognized your mother’s locket the very first week you came to care for her, {{player_name}}. She wanted to see your heart before telling you.
If that caretaker proves she is my sister’s daughter, I lose the whole estate—

nodes.transcript: [urgent whisper] {{player_name}}, Celeste just cornered me in the pantry! She offered me $200,000 cash to swear in court that Lady Eleanor had dementia when she signed the will!

nodes.prompt: Celeste is trying to bribe Edgar and contest the will! How do you counter?

options.label: Have Edgar play along & record her bribe
options.player_reply_text: Edgar, tell her you’ll "think about it" and capture her next offer on voice memo—Sterling will hand it straight to the judge.

options.label: Drop the DNA report into the family thread
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Sterling, share the sealed DNA report with the trustees—let Celeste explain why she called her own niece "the help"!

nodes.text: BAIT TAKEN: Five minutes later, Celeste texts Edgar the exact $200K bribe terms in black and white!
ESTATE SHOCKWAVE: The trustees freeze Celeste’s 49% voting proxy immediately pending investigation!
I don’t care what fake lab paper Sterling waves around! I’m filing an injunction tonight—and nobody touches the West Wing study!
Why is Celeste so terrified of anyone opening the West Wing study? That’s where Lady Eleanor kept the 2002 family trust ledger…

nodes.headline: Secret Of The West Wing
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Discover why Celeste is desperate to burn the 2002 ledger before dawn.

nodes.text: 11:50 PM · Thorne Manor. Thunder rolls over the estate as Celeste’s injunction threat hangs in the dark.
Take $500,000 cash and walk away tonight, {{player_name}}. You weren’t raised for this estate—the board will eat you alive.
I spent three years by Grandmother’s bedside while you only showed up to ask for allowances, Celeste. I’m not going anywhere.
{{player_name}}, I just reviewed Eleanor’s private notes about 2002: Celeste’s late husband forged your mother’s disinheritance letter to drive her out of the estate!
If they find my 2002 letter in the West Wing safe I’ll lose my 49% too—
ALERT! The West Wing corridor motion sensor just tripped—someone just picked the lock to Lady Eleanor’s private study!

nodes.transcript: [rain hammering glass] {{player_name}}, it’s Celeste! She has a lighter and she’s pulling the 2002 ledger out of the wall safe right now!

nodes.prompt: Celeste is about to burn the 2002 proof in the West Wing! What do you do?

options.label: Flip the corridor lights & confront her
options.player_reply_text: Edgar, flip the master lights and unlock the study door—catch her red-handed on estate security cam!

options.label: Lock West Wing doors + summon Sterling
options.player_reply_text: Lock the West Wing foyer and video-call Mr. Sterling live so he witnesses every second of her arson attempt!

nodes.text: CAUGHT IN THE ACT: Blinding chandelier lights snap on—Celeste freezes with the lighter an inch from the ledger!
LIVE LEGAL WITNESS: Mr. Sterling records Celeste’s panic on live video—triggering the estate’s total-forfeiture clause!
Put the lighter down, Aunt Celeste. Grandmother already made a video testament weeks before she passed.
A… video testament?! No—she couldn’t have known about 2002!

nodes.headline: Midnight In The West Wing
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Present the security shadow footage and Eleanor’s final video to end Celeste’s claim forever.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Estate Grand Salon. The trustees watch the West Wing security alert and Eleanor’s final video.
Here is the West Wing security still from 11:54 PM, Trustees—plus the intact 2002 ledger proving how {{player_name}}’s mother was framed.

nodes.caption: WEST WING CAM · 23:54 — Celeste breaking into Matriarch Eleanor’s sealed study to burn the 2002 ledger.

nodes.text: Wait—you’re going to take away my 49% too?! Where am I supposed to go?!
Under Clause 8, attempting to bribe a witness or destroy estate records automatically forfeits a beneficiary’s share to the primary heir.
I spent twenty years scheming for this house and lost 100% of it in one night—

nodes.transcript: [video audio echoing softly] "My dearest {{player_name}}, you tended to me when you thought I owed you nothing. Now this entire estate—and your mother’s good name—belong to you."

nodes.prompt: 100% of the Thorne Estate now rests in your hands! What fate do you decide for Celeste?

options.label: Evict her with a modest living stipend
options.player_reply_text: Leave the estate by sunset, Celeste. I’ll give you a modest apartment stipend—on condition you never contest Mother’s name again.

options.label: Enforce 100% forfeiture & clear Mom’s name
options.player_reply_text: Enforce full forfeiture under Clause 8—and hang my mother’s portrait back in the Grand Salon where it belongs!

nodes.text: GRACEFUL POWER: Even the oldest trustees bow their heads in awe of your quiet dignity.
JUSTICE RESTORED: Celeste departs in silence as Edgar hangs your mother’s portrait beside Eleanor’s.
The staff are all smiling again, Miss {{player_name}}. Welcome home—truly.
Thank you, Edgar. And please—never call me "the caretaker" again.

nodes.headline: The Thorne Legacy Begins
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Take your rightful seat at the head of the Thorne estate and honor both Eleanor and your mother.

nodes.text: One Month Later · Estate Rose Garden. Lanterns shimmer over the lawn as the estate reopens to warmth and light.
Probate officially closed this afternoon with zero objections, {{player_name}}. The Thorne Estate is 100% yours.
From the quiet caretaker nobody noticed to honoring my mother’s name in the Grand Salon… still feels like a dream.
The roses Lady Eleanor planted for your mother just bloomed this morning—brightest they’ve looked in twenty-four years.
Maybe Grandmother was right—{{player_name}} was always the better heir—

nodes.transcript: [soft strings playing] All twenty staff members are gathered in the courtyard to toast the new Lady of the Manor, {{player_name}}!

nodes.text: Coming down right now—and tonight, the staff sit AT the main table with me.

nodes.prompt: Your first official decree as head of the Thorne Estate:

options.label: Double Edgar’s & the staff’s retirement fund
options.player_reply_text: Doubling retirement trusts for Edgar and every loyal staff member who cared for Grandmother!

options.label: Launch a Caregivers’ Scholarship Foundation
options.player_reply_text: Doubling staff pensions AND launching the Eleanor Thorne Caregivers’ Foundation to support quiet heroes everywhere!

nodes.text: DEEPEST LOYALTY: Edgar bows with glistening eyes—this estate will never know cruelty again.
BELOVED LEGACY: Mr. Sterling raises his glass—"Eleanor chose a true queen to carry her crown."
Long live the rightful heir of Thorne Manor.
Welcome home, Miss {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: FINALE · The Rightful Crown
nodes.teaser_text: You uncovered your hidden birthright, thwarted the midnight sabotage, and restored honor to your family.
